tasks.title: Investigate CLI/runtime split decision
tasks.description: Binary size analysis: debug=7.4MB, release=TBD (build broken). Dependencies include WebKit, Cocoa, LuaJIT. Decision: keep single binary for now (7.4MB is fine), split only if CLI grows significantly or for App Store distribution.

tasks.title: EPIC: coconut bundle — standalone distributable app packaging
tasks.description: coconut bundle reads project config, generates platform manifests (Info.plist, app.manifest, .desktop, metainfo.xml), assembles .app bundle with binary + config + assets + commands. Full pipeline works end-to-end. Remaining: B2 bytecode opt-in, codesign.

tasks.title: Bundle-aware binary — detect .app bundle at startup (option B)
tasks.description: On macOS, use NSBundle.mainBundle to detect if running from inside a .app. If so, resolve project root to .app/Contents/Resources. This removes the need for a shell launcher script.

tasks.title: Add darwin/win/linux + manifests fields to Config struct
tasks.description: Extend Config with darwin, win, linux, and manifests structs. Support global+override pattern (e.g. frameless=global default, darwin.frameless overrides). Implement merge order: defaults → global → platform.

tasks.title: Parse platform + manifests tables from coconut.config.lua
tasks.description: Read darwin/win/linux and manifests tables in loadConfigLua(). Merge with merge order. Validate fields. Store in Config struct. No rebuild needed — all runtime.

tasks.title: Dynamic NSBundle patching for macOS manifests at startup
tasks.description: At runtime startup, read darwin.* config and mutate NSBundle.mainBundle.infoDictionary in-memory: bundle_identifier, ns_permissions, extra_plist keys. Used in dev mode (outside .app bundle) so all features work without rebuild.

tasks.title: coconut bundle: generate Info.plist from config + manifests.darwin
tasks.description: Render macOS Info.plist XML from config fields (bundle_identifier, cf_bundle_name, version, category, ns_permissions, extra_plist). Place in .app/Contents/Info.plist.

tasks.title: coconut bundle: generate Windows app.manifest
tasks.description: Render Windows app.manifest XML with Common Controls dependency, DPI awareness, compatibility OS GUIDs. Place alongside .exe.

tasks.title: coconut bundle: generate .desktop + metainfo.xml for Linux
tasks.description: Render .desktop file from linux.* config (name, exec, categories, extra_desktop_keys). Render metainfo.xml from linux.appstream config.

tasks.title: coconut bundle: assemble directory structure + copy files
tasks.description: Create .app/Contents/{MacOS,Resources} structure. Copy binary, stripped config, views, assets, commands, main.lua, icon.icns. Set executable permissions.

tasks.title: EPIC: CLI improvements — new, run, generate, bundle subcommands
tasks.description: coconut new (scaffold), coconut run (config override flags), coconut bundle (packaging), coconut generate. --help per subcommand. --version. Subcommand routing.

tasks.title: coconut new — scaffold projects from templates
tasks.description: coconut new <project-name> delegates to create-coconut-app Lua script. Supports --template (bare, bare-ts, vite). --yes flag. Script found by walking up from binary directory.

tasks.title: coconut run — dev workflow improvements
tasks.description: coconut run subcommand. Config override flags: --window-width, --window-height, --frameless, --transparent, --title. Overrides applied after config load, before window creation.

tasks.title: coconut generate — polish existing generator
tasks.description: Print clearer output (what was generated). Respect custom output_dir from config. Generate .d.ts + .g.js alongside .g.lua. Skip unchanged files (mtime check). --watch for auto-regeneration on file changes.

tasks.title: CLI help system + subcommand routing
tasks.description: coconut --help shows available subcommands and run flags. <subcommand> --help per-subcommand help. --version. Subcommand routing: generate | new | run | bundle all dispatched.

tasks.title: Opt-in: compile config to bytecode on bundle (B2)
tasks.description: When bundle.bytecode_config is true: compile the stripped coconut.config.lua to .luac via luajit -b <arch> before bundling. Runtime loader handles .luac transparently. User must bundle separately per arch if using this opt-in.

tasks.title: Strip dev-only fields from config on bundle (Option A default)
tasks.description: When bundling, coconut.config.lua gets dev fields removed: generators.*, debug.*, manifests.*, bundle.*. The stripped config ships in .app/Contents/Resources/coconut.config.lua. Runtime loads it when running from .app. Bundle-aware binary (option B) points to Resources/.

tasks.title: Static-link LuaJIT in release builds
tasks.description: Link libluajit.a statically so the shipped binary has zero dylib deps. Debug keeps dynamic for iteration speed. xmake: use add_requires with shared=false config or add_linkdirs/add_links for the .a file.

tasks.title: Fix 11 failing tests — config JSON validation + FS edge cases
tasks.description: Pre-existing failures: config view kind validation (5), FS path resolution (3), platform style JSON validation (2), bridge null config (1). All are config parser / FS interface mismatch issues.

tasks.title: Bundle: codesign — codesign --deep in assembly step
tasks.description: After bundle assembly, optionally run codesign --deep on the .app bundle. Check for identity in config or use ad-hoc signing. Non-critical (bundle works without it).
